description: This file contains unit tests for the litellm proxy server, specifically testing the ability to run a local proxy server with Gunicorn for local testing purposes. It includes setup for environment variables, configuration paths, and a function to start the server using subprocess.

methods.name: get_openai_info
methods.description: Retrieves API key and base URL for Azure OpenAI from environment variables.

methods.name: run_server
methods.description: Sets environment variables and runs Gunicorn to start the proxy server with specified host, port, and worker count.
